id: title:Gilbert09:stop retrying a refused warehouse bucket check

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion reliability and credential failure handling
review.reason: The change adds botocore and warehouse-specific imports, including NonRetryableException, to the S3 common module. It also adds a helper function to detect S3 access refusal, checking both HTTP 403 status and explicit error codes. Additionally, it wraps bucket existence check in a try/except, re-raising only non-forbidden errors and raising NonRetryableException for forbidden. This
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the observed implementation of warehouse ingestion error handling, but the actual impact on warehouse ingestion and the benefit of this change is not verified.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No adoption, incident, or effort claims are supported. No tier assignment is made; this chunk is not scored.

observations.behavior: Adds botocore and warehouse-specific imports, including NonRetryableException, to the S3 common module.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides the exception class and library needed to distinguish credential/policy failures from transient S3 errors in warehouse ingestion.

observations.behavior: Adds a helper function to detect S3 access refusal, checking both HTTP 403 status and explicit error codes.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows warehouse ingestion to recognize credential or policy denials and stop retrying, preventing repeated failures and unnecessary resource consumption.

observations.behavior: Wraps bucket existence check in a try/except, re-raising only non-forbidden errors and raising NonRetryableException for forbidden access.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes warehouse ingestion behavior: transient or recoverable S3 errors remain retryable, while credential or policy failures are treated as terminal, avoiding repeated failed attempts.
